actor_choice: g4 both seeds fixed before new evaluation; no g8 cherry-picking
frozen_parts: all RGB v1 red, green, blue, existing router
hypotheses: H1 full-draft risk predicts whole program outcome better than single-step confidence
H2 compare risk head using green summary versus same allocated head with green/command vectors zeroed
H3 blue drafts verified in parallel by deterministic red greedily preserve red actions at lower serial latency; may fail speed test

risk_training.seed_rule: same seed and input stream for full and stats-only
risk_training.target: not(exact target bytes AND explicit STOP AND (edit task OR no EDIT proposals))
risk_training.save: fixed terminal checkpoint; no selection of training steps
risk_training.features: 144: 64 initial green means + 64 last green means + 16 draft statistics; stats-only masks first128 with zeros, same allocated head but fewer active inputs

calibration.constraints: zero previously-red-successful cases lost; zero new no-op false edits; minimum 16 accepted drafts
calibration.selection: largest accepted count then lower threshold; if none, force red. No final test used for tuning.

fresh_tests.novelty: exact bytes and neutral fingerprint checked against expanded v2 release and accessible RGB v1 splits; same generator family, not project split

verification.comparison: position and replacement value, including STOP; only matched prefix committed; red correction at first mismatch; remaining work red-only
verification.no_model_answer_used: no oracle labels, execution outcomes, task family or target reachability used in inference
verification.conditional_guarantee: greedy red equivalence if per-state red output independent of batching; numerical comparison tested, not universal correctness proof

metrics: actual blue/red model rows and calls
default: red_only unchanged; no deployment or stable-parent promotion
metrics_note: Primary false edits counts committed returned EDIT proposals as v1 did; raw speculative EDIT proposals, including rejected drafts, are separately reported on no-op inputs. Scratch bytes never modify input files.
runtime_batch_note: verified red batch maximum32; single speculative block max4 actions then red-only continuation under shared 9-action budget
